purpose: Offline prerequisite inventory for PR #18; not provisioning, workload, policy-load, merge, publication, or deployment authorization.

source.reconciliation: Checkpoint absent from available local commit objects and unresolved by read-only GitHub commit lookup. This does not prove global nonexistence. The design and candidate revisions are references, not administrator-approved experiment inputs.

target_claims.warning: Values transcribed from the pinned design, not authenticated image/package pins or independently inspected host properties.

requirements.required_evidence: Exact image URL/release, architecture, image SHA-256, authenticated checksum/signature evidence, and boot configuration.
Exact QEMU/KVM version, executable/package hashes, CPU model, immutable base and disposable overlay identity; no shared-kernel substitute.
Exact kernel package/build, authenticated package checksums, matching source/config and Ubuntu patches; a release string alone is insufficient.
Full distribution revision, binary/source-package hashes, build flags, patches, linked libc/libselinux versions and authenticated package provenance.
Full package revision, parser configuration, ABI 4.0 includes, kernel feature tree and domain/stack support; parser version is not kernel LSM identity.

Administrator-approved experiment revision and authenticated source artifact digest; reconcile Phase V or explicitly approve its exclusion. Reference revisions alone do not select an authoritative experiment.

Reviewed policy source/compiled hashes, compiler/includes, actual loaded-policy provenance and enforcing labels; separately identify restored baseline and unchanged candidate, one-rule launcher diff and identical worker hashes.
Exact interpreter/package hashes and complete resolved dependency wheel closure with authenticated origin; lower-bound requirements are not a lock.
Root-owned input artifact hashes, signed Ubuntu archive snapshot/package closure, reviewed build commands/logs, read-only input-media identity and no-secret inventory.

Separately authorized, sanitized administrator export: complete audit serial groups and loss counters, UTC/monotonic bounds, boot identity, PID/start-time/label/exit/stderr correlation, installed binary/package/kernel identity and loaded-policy provenance. Do not retrieve from DigitalOcean.

Independent administrator verifies root ownership/non-worker-writability of source, environment, policies, inputs and control state; workload identity UID/GID 1000 has no sudo, privilege groups, credentials or approval rights.

Independent administrator reviews authenticated serial-console access and an external stop/recovery procedure, with separately authorized recovery verification evidence. No unauthenticated console, embedded credentials, or unloading policy under workers.

review.rule: The governed agent cannot approve inputs, change enforcement authority, or clear readiness blockers. All missing pins/evidence and human review block readiness.

completion_rule: This version only records a blocked inventory. Complete authenticated pins and sanitized administrator evidence, then obtain independent human review in a successor revision; never substitute guessed versions, latest, worker self-report, or passing mocks. A different package set is a mechanism experiment, not host-equivalent acceptance.
preservation_rule: Never let the thing behind the switch own the switch. Preserve default-deny model egress, encrypted storage, authentication/authorization, human approvals, auditability, external shutdown, and Linux isolation. Do not weaken controls to fill prerequisites.
